metadata.technology_specification: Flow Cytometer (standard benchtop model with fluorescence detection)
metadata.technology_reasoning: Conventional benchtop flow cytometers with fluorescence detection represent the most common standard in research and clinical labs globally as of 2024 due to their versatility in multi-parameter cell analysis, broad adoption, and well-established manufacturing frameworks.

components.reasoning: The fluidics system is essential for transporting cells in a single stream through the laser interrogation point; universally present and typically sourced as a distinct subsystem.
Core functional unit that excites fluorescent markers and detects emitted light; almost always a separate module with specific supplier chains for lasers and photodetectors.
Includes amplification, filtering, data acquisition, and processing circuits; central to converting optical signals into digital data, always present as a dedicated subsystem.

components.component: Sample Injection Port and Tubing Assembly
components.reasoning: Structural and functional component for introducing samples into the fluidics system; widely standardized and supplied as separate assemblies.
Includes touchscreen or button interfaces and software controllers; standard separate module for device operation and data visualization.
Collects used fluid and cells post-analysis; common subsystem critical for operation hygiene, often modular and separately sourced.
Protective housing and structural framework ensuring system stability and safety; a standardized mechanical assembly distinct from electronic and fluidics modules.

Fluidics System.name: Polyethylene
Fluidics System.reasoning: Used extensively in tubing and fluid pathways due to chemical resistance and flexibility, industry standard in fluid handling systems.

Fluidics System.name: Stainless steel
Fluidics System.reasoning: Essential for durable, corrosion-resistant internal components and connectors exposed to fluids, commonly used in precision fluidics systems.

Fluidics System.name: PTFE coating
Fluidics System.reasoning: Applied as a surface treatment inside channels to reduce fluid adhesion and biofouling; alternatives exist but PTFE coating is common.

Fluidics System.name: Polytetrafluoroethylene
Fluidics System.reasoning: Material for fluidic seals and gaskets due to chemical inertness; some substitution possible but widely used.

Optical System (Lasers and Detectors).name: Aluminum gallium arsenide
Optical System (Lasers and Detectors).reasoning: Key semiconductor material for laser diodes emitting in the near-infrared, essential for laser function in flow cytometers.

Optical System (Lasers and Detectors).name: Indium gallium arsenide
Optical System (Lasers and Detectors).reasoning: Used in photodetectors for high sensitivity detection of emitted signals from fluorescent dyes, industry standard.

Optical System (Lasers and Detectors).name: Glass
Optical System (Lasers and Detectors).reasoning: Optical components such as lenses and windows require high optical clarity; glass is industry standard substrate.

Optical System (Lasers and Detectors).name: Photomultiplier tube materials
Optical System (Lasers and Detectors).reasoning: Crucial in detectors for photon multiplication and signal amplification; materials are specialized but integral.

Optical System (Lasers and Detectors).name: Aluminum
Optical System (Lasers and Detectors).reasoning: Structural frames and heat sinks for lasers and detectors often made from aluminum due to thermal conductivity.

Electronics and Signal Processing Unit.name: Silicon

Electronics and Signal Processing Unit.name: Copper
Electronics and Signal Processing Unit.reasoning: Widely used as conductor in printed circuit boards and wiring, industry standard.

Electronics and Signal Processing Unit.name: Epoxy resins
Electronics and Signal Processing Unit.reasoning: Used as encapsulants and adhesives in electronic assemblies to protect components; common standard.

Electronics and Signal Processing Unit.name: Gold
Electronics and Signal Processing Unit.reasoning: Used in thin coatings and connectors to ensure reliable electrical contact and corrosion resistance, alternatives exist but gold is standard.

Electronics and Signal Processing Unit.name: Aluminum
Electronics and Signal Processing Unit.reasoning: Used in heat sinks and some conductive paths; alternatives exist but aluminum common due to cost and thermal properties.

Sample Injection Port and Tubing Assembl.name: Polyethylene

Sample Injection Port and Tubing Assembl.name: Stainless steel

Sample Injection Port and Tubing Assembl.name: PTFE coating

Sample Injection Port and Tubing Assembl.name: Polytetrafluoroethylene

User Interface and Control Panel.name: Silicon
User Interface and Control Panel.reasoning: Used in display driver semiconductors and touch sensors; alternatives exist but silicon dominates electronics.

Waste Collection System.name: Polytetrafluoroethylene
